## 2026-07-24 - [Rejected: Optimize Frontmatter Parsing in plugins/]
**Learning:** [The `plugins/` directory is generated by `scripts/sync-plugins.sh` from the source repository on every release. Any optimization (like the frontmatter parser rewrite) applied here will be overwritten at the next release.]
